items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: another very good trumpet player who was in and out of the band for a short period, he'd been in and out of the band on numerous occasions -- his name is Ray Lind.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Cubby was constantly steaming up different guys, people like Pete, and how some of these things started, just from ribbing and kidding. And all of a sudden another very good trumpet player who was in and out of the band for a short period, he'd been in and out of the band on numerous occasions -- his name is Ray Lind.
